parts.label: One-line summary
parts.prompt: One short sentence: what does remove(L, v) do?

fields.label: summary
accept: removes the first node after the start whose value is v by linking past it
removes the first occurrence of v that is not the first node
finds the first node with value v that is not at first and unlinks it
skips the first node with value v if it is not the head
fields.hint: The loop checks x.next.value, not x.value.

accept: removes all nodes with value v
traps.hint: Only one node is unlinked when x.next matches.

accept: removes the first node with value v
traps.hint: If v is only in L.first, the loop never removes it.
